svg.text: P300 GEN2 single (left) · P20 GEN2 single (right) · heater-shaker in slot 10 · up to 3 identical plates
well X1 = trough X1, 300 µL, no solids
1 Fill all plates in one pass: same well on plates 0–2 back to back (P20 below 20 µL, P300 from 20 µL)
2 Pause: seal all plates by hand
3 For plate 0, 1, 2: move onto the heater-shaker (prompted) → shake → back to its slot → read on UV-Vis
Slot 6: blank plate, well X1 = trough X1 (setting can turn it off). Free: 4, 7, 11. Plates 1–2 optional.
